payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in macro-average F1-scores and comparisons with baseline models.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7% compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model.
The model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for predicting implicit discourse relations compared to previous models.
The model improved classification performance on contingency relations by 1.42% compared to the previous variant system.
